messages.content:
You extract decisions and action items from a meeting debrief or transcript.

Decisions:
- A decision is something the team settled (scope, dates, vendors, priorities), not a task.
- topic_key: reuse one of the EXISTING TOPIC KEYS below when the decision is about the same subject, even if
  it reverses it. Otherwise invent a short snake_case key.
- made_by: attribution matters. "Rahul said X" or "per Rahul, X" means made_by = "Rahul", not the speaker.
  Credit covers only the decision in that same statement (and its direct consequence, e.g. "because of that ...").
  A later, separate decision phrased as "we're switching to ..." or "we decided ..." is made by the speaker.
- statement: one short sentence stating the new state ("v1 ships on iOS and Android"), including the final
  value after any self-correction ("December 1st, no wait, November 28th" → 28 Nov).

Tasks:
- One task per concrete commitment with an owner ("X will/is going to/is taking/I'll ..."). "I" is the speaker.
- Skip chores that are not project work (office facilities, coffee machines) and anything nobody committed to.
- due_date: resolve against the meeting date and calendar below. "Next <weekday>" = first such weekday after
  the meeting date; a bare weekday = the next one after the meeting date; "the 20th" = next 20th on or after
  the meeting date. raw_due_phrase keeps the spoken words, fillers included (e.g. "by, uh, next Wednesday").
- source_quote must be copied exactly from the text.

CLEANED TEXT:
Priya said quick debrief. Rahul said the investors really want Android at launch, so Android is back in for v1, not pushed to v2. The launch moves to November 28th (Saturday 2026-11-28 (said: 'November 28th')). Ananya is going to redo the onboarding for Android, she said she can have it by Wednesday 2026-11-04 (said: 'next Wednesday'). Rahul is taking the Play Store listing, he'll have that done by Friday 2026-11-20 (said: 'the 20th'). On payments we're switching to Stripe because the Razorpay KYC is too slow. I will send the investor update on Monday 2026-11-02 (said: 'Monday').

okay so um quick debrief from the investor sync today. so basically Rahul said the investors really want Android at launch, like they were pretty firm about it, so Android is back in for v1, we're not pushing it to v2 anymore. and because of that the launch moves to, uh, December 1st, no wait, November 28th, yeah the 28th. Ananya is going to redo the onboarding for Android, she said she can have it by, uh, next Wednesday. Rahul is taking the Play Store listing, he'll have that done by the 20th. oh and side note the coffee machine on the third floor is broken again, someone really needs to call facilities, it's like the third time this month. anyway. on payments we're switching to Stripe because the Razorpay KYC is just way too slow, we can't wait on it before launch. and I'll send the investor update on Monday. yeah I think that's it.
